codes.title: More than one chart overlay

messages.text: [cngx-chart] more than one *cngxChartOverlay projected; only the first renders. Compose multiple overlays inside a single overlay template.

codes.title: Two chart axes share one orientation

messages.text: [cngx-chart] multiple axes share one orientation; only the first drives the scale, the rest render their line and ticks but their [domain] is silently ignored. Mount one X and one Y axis per chart.

codes.title: Chart preset without an accessible name

codes.title: Grid recycler without columns

codes.title: Per-index size estimate on a large recycler

codes.title: Recycler scroll element not found on first render

codes.title: Second dialog title or description registered

messages.text: [cngxDialog] dialog "${...}" has a second ${...} registered while another is live. The dialog references one ${...} id, and both elements render it; a template-declared ${...} wins over a registered one. Remove the extra cngxDialog${...} element.

codes.title: Non-modal dialog without a title

messages.text: [cngxDialog] non-modal dialog "${...}" opened without a title. A non-modal dialog leaves focus on the page and is announced only by reading its title into its live region; with no title text, screen reader users are not told it appeared. Add a [cngxDialogTitle] element with text.

codes.title: Status without an accessible name

messages.text: [cngx-status] no `label`; the status has no accessible name and reads only as a coloured dot. Set [label]: the host has no role, so an aria-label or aria-labelledby on it is not a valid name.

codes.title: Status reduced to a bare coloured dot

messages.text: [cngx-status] [glyph]="false" with no visible `label`; a bare coloured dot is colour-only for a sighted colour-blind reader even with an aria-label. Set [label] or show the glyph.

codes.title: Tag group label without a semantic list

messages.text: [cngx-tag-group] [label] is bound without [semanticList]="true"; the aria-label lands on a generic <div>. Add [semanticList]="true" to expose role="list" + aria-label, or remove [label].

codes.title: Two directives bind `aria-busy` on one element

messages.text: [cngxAsyncStatus] and [cngxAsyncClick] on the same element both bind aria-busy. Use one or the other.

codes.title: Duplicate error source key

messages.text: addSource(): an error source with key "${...}" is already registered; the new entry replaces it (last-wins). Use unique keys per source.

codes.title: Duplicate name in the error registry

registerScope(): a scope named "${...}" is already registered. The existing instance stays live (swap-is-noop); unregister it first for a true swap.

codes.title: Option without a label

messages.text: [cngxOption] option ${...} has no label and no textContent. Label is required for AT and trigger display.

codes.title: Submenu directive without a menu item

messages.text: [cngxMenuItemSubmenu] applied without a sibling [cngxMenuItem] on the same host element. The surrounding CngxMenuTrigger cannot route ArrowRight / activation to this submenu because CngxActiveDescendant only highlights CngxMenuItem nodes. Add [cngxMenuItem] alongside [cngxMenuItemSubmenu] on the same element.

messages.text: [cngxMenuItemSubmenu] has no popover/menu source. Bind [cngxMenuItemSubmenu] and [submenuMenu], or provide CNGX_MENU_SUBMENU_WIRING from a wrapping component. The brain stays inert (no aria-haspopup / aria-expanded) until one is present.

codes.title: Submenu popover without position fallbacks

messages.text: [cngxMenu] focus(): host element has tabindex < 0; with tabindex="-1" focus() still lands but the menu drops out of the Tab sequence, without a tabindex focus() does nothing. Add tabindex="0" to the cngxMenu host so the menu container receives keyboard focus.

codes.title: Reorder items without an index

messages.text: [cngxReorder] ${...} element(s) match itemSelector "${...}" but carry no non-negative integer data-reorder-index. Pointer / keyboard moves targeting them will be ignored.

codes.title: Duplicate tree selection key

messages.text: createTreeController(): duplicate selection key "${...}" from keyFn - the earlier node is shadowed in selection lookups. Keys must be unique.

codes.title: Sticky header in a container that cannot scroll

messages.text: [cngxStickyHeader] resolves against a scroll container that cannot scroll in the block axis (client height equals scroll height), so this header will never pin. Give the scrollport a bounded block-size, or drop cngxStickyHeader.

codes.title: Confirm popover action without an action

messages.text: [cngx-popover-action] role="confirm" without an [action] renders a button whose click runs nothing and leaves the popover open. Bind [action] or use role="dismiss".

messages.text: [cngx-timeline-item] focusable content inside [cngxTimelineOpposite]. The slot projects ahead of the row body, so under placement="end" or "alternate" it takes focus before the row it belongs to while painting on the far side of the rail. Keep opposite content non-interactive and put controls in the body.

[cngxNumericInput] This numeric input uses Angular's DefaultValueAccessor, so the form control gets display strings instead of numbers. For Reactive Forms, import CngxFormBridge from @cngx/forms/controls; [ngModel] is not supported, use [(value)] or Signal Forms.
